title: Full Pockets
tagline: Grab the glints. Mind the snake. Know when to leave.
teaser: A treasure garden, a door, and one very interested snake. Every coin you pocket makes it bolder; every step you take, it takes one too. Bank your haul at the door, or stay for one more shiny thing. Turn-based nerve, straight from a Berkeley terminal.

manPage.synopsis: snake — step for step with a snake, pick up the glints, and leave by the door before it catches you.
manPage.description: A reborn snake, the turn-based treasure chase from the 1980 Berkeley games. The snake grows bolder the richer you are, its odds are shown on the board, every door asks whether to bank or go deeper, and the original rules wait in Classic, quirks and all.

howToPlay: Every step you take, the snake takes one: pick up glints and keep clear of its six squares.
The fuller your pockets, the bolder it gets; the strike preview shows where it may land next.
Every door asks: bank your haul and end the run, or go deeper for richer glints.
